[SWS_CM_10491] Re-establishing service connection
⌈
In case the ser-
vice becomes temporarily unavailable (due to restart, network problem or so), or if an
error occurs while establishing a connection to the service, the error shall be logged,
and the Communication Managament shall retry to establish the connection once the
next offer is received.
⌋
